text:
support-bot: New ticket #7892 from acme-corp — reported 'sudden hallucinations in product descriptions' after this morning's rollout. https://support.example/tickets/7892 :warning:

maria: Taking this. Customer shows outputs inventing features that don't exist. They say it started around 06:30 UTC.

ajay: Can you paste a direct example from the customer? Also checking if any model or config rollouts happened around that time.

maria: Customer example (copied):
	"We asked the model to summarise the Acme Widget specs and it added a section about 'autonomous cooling' and a proprietary 'FluxDrive' that we never shipped. This began after your deploy this morning."

ajay: Thanks. I checked deploy logs — there was a config PR merged right before 06:25 that adjusted model serving profiles. deploy-bot: Rollout ID r-2024-11-05-06:24 commit abc123 PR#2345 applied to hosted cluster.

deploy-bot: rollout r-2024-11-05-06:24 completed on 06:26 UTC, changed model profile 'chat-standard' sampling defaults.

ajay: Looking at the diff in PR#2345, sampling defaults were accidentally bumped. Snippet from the PR: 
```yaml
# before (intended default)
sampling:
  temperature: 0.2
  top_p: 0.9

# after PR#2345 (accidental)
sampling:
  temperature: 0.8
  top_p: 0.99
```

eve: :facepalm: that's almost certainly it — raising temperature/top_p by that much would increase creative completions and hallucinations. That PR was meant to tune generation for a downstream eval, not change global defaults.

ajay: Repro steps for support/engineering: call the hosted generate endpoint with no explicit temperature/top_p (so defaults are used). Example curl the customer used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"chat-standard","input":"Summarize the Acme Widget features"}' 
```
You can see hallucinated lines in the response. If you explicitly set temperature: 0.2 top_p: 0.9 in the payload, output returns to expected, non-inventive content.

maria: I ran that with the customer and they confirm: hitting the endpoint without overrides shows fabricated features; explicit low-temp override fixes the behavior. Customer asked us to revert ASAP. :raised_hands:

ajay: Rolling back the sampling defaults on hosted now (reverting PR#2345). I'll push a hotfix to restore the intended defaults and add a guard.

eve: Please also notify customers who may have relied on implicit defaults. We should add a note in status and a follow-up to change management. :eyes:

ajay: Done — hotfix deployed at r-2024-11-05-06:58, revert commit def456. Customer reports improved outputs.

maria: Customer confirmed reduced hallucinations and is satisfied for now. They've asked for a short postmortem and CI check to catch future default drift.

ajay: I'll open a postmortem ticket and add a unit test that asserts sampling defaults in model profiles don't change without explicit PR flag. Also proposing a required change-notes checkbox on PRs touching sampling.

eve: Sounds good — assign to @ajay and cc @maria for customer comms.

maria: Will draft the customer-facing note and the incident summary for ops. Closing thread once postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
